name: Workflow B - User-Loan Matching & Optimization Funnel

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.id AS user_db_id,
  u.user_id,
  u.email,
  u.monthly_income,
  u.credit_score,
  u.employment_status,
  u.age,
  p.id AS product_db_id,
  p.provider_name,
  p.product_name,
  p.interest_rate,
  p.min_credit_score,
  p.min_monthly_income,
  p.processing_fee_pct,
  p.max_loan_amount
FROM users u
INNER JOIN loan_products p 
  ON p.is_active = TRUE
 AND u.credit_score >= p.min_credit_score
 AND u.monthly_income >= p.min_monthly_income
 AND u.age BETWEEN p.min_age AND p.max_age
 AND u.employment_status = ANY(p.allowed_employment_statuses)
WHERE u.job_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY u.user_id, p.interest_rate ASC;

INSERT INTO matches (
  job_id, 
  user_id, 
  product_id, 
  match_score, 
  archetype_key, 
  eligibility_reason, 
  is_notified
) VALUES (
  $1::uuid, $2::uuid, $3::uuid, $4, $5, $6, FALSE
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id, job_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
